title: Structured worker question handoff
description: Manual disposable authenticated gateway proof. Native registration and tmux are fixtures; no model or product slot starts.

question.intent: Read one monitor decision through authenticated run.get, retain it through unknown and foreign answers, then automatically return to monitoring after the exact tool result, without nudges or pane-derived question state.

permission.intent: A valid native Bash transcript with no AskUserQuestion preserves the existing permission handoff until that permission closes; known-empty structured questions cannot suppress or close it. Reuses the existing permission fixture, no new renderer parsing.
